# Governance Requirements Quality Checklist: Terminal Spec Toolkit

**Purpose**: Gate 2 review of how well the requirements cover spec governance and registry integrity: validation rule coverage, conversion fidelity, value-layer separation, registry immutability and versioning, and routing data for demo moments
**Created**: 2026-11-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Validation Rule Coverage

- [ ] CHK001 Is the severity model (error, warning, info), and which severities fail validation, defined in the spec rather than only in the contracts? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, contracts/validation-rules.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Does each requirement in FR-008 map to at least one rule id in the rules contract, with no rule lacking a requirement behind it? [Traceability, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the L5 bump-level table (patch, minor, major per change type) part of the requirements, or only of research, given that FR-008 refers to "the rule table in the plan"? [Traceability, Spec §FR-008, research R-10]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified how validation behaves when the L5 git baseline is unavailable (shallow clone, container), and is that consistent between FR-011 and the CLI contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, contracts/adlc-spec-cli.md]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the identifier namespaces allowed in expressions (`param.`, `tier.`, `run.`, `profile.`, evidence sources, terminal ids) stated as requirements, so that V-12 has a defined pass or fail? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, research R-02]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the namespacing of TDS run variables (`rework_count` → `run.rework_count`) recorded as a dictionary change the TDS must adopt? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the semantics of separation-of-duty groups defined well enough to tell a legitimate overlap from a violation (for example, every terminal holds `write:T<n>.artifacts`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "terminating outcome" defined (terminate, lifecycle closed, special terminating destinations), so that route reachability (V-22) can be judged? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Conversion Fidelity

- [ ] CHK009 Is the default route for `exception` outcomes that have no explicit route in the TDS (for example, T0, T1, T5) specified, so that conversion does not invent behaviour? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, TDS §3]
- [ ] CHK010 Does FR-013's "keep TDS wording as description" cover every converted element type (routes, timers, sign-off rules), not only conditions and rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the criteria for "removed" elements in the conversion record defined (who approves a removal, and what reasons are acceptable)? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it specified how TDS values that are not a duration (`1d+3d_hypercare`, `2d_past_review_due`, `per review_schedule`) are expressed after conversion? [Clarity, Spec US3, research R-16]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "applicability on every metric requirement, where one exists" defined, given that the TDS has no metric-requirement element outside the T1 tiering lists? [Ambiguity, Spec US3]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the additions `max_auto_retries` and the change-class projection, which appear in the plan but not the spec, either added to the spec or justified as plan-level detail? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, plan Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the list of special route destinations (`human_completion`, `owning_terminal`, boards, `lifecycle_closed`, `itsm`) enumerated or bounded in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-004]

## Value-Layer Separation (Constitution I, II)

- [ ] CHK016 Is the boundary between guardrail parameters and `controls.tiering` settings stated as a rule future spec authors can apply, not only as a list for this conversion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK017 Is tighten-only defined for non-numeric guardrails (for example, the list of RAI metric classes required per tier)? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, research R-08]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the requirements consistent about where "proposed default" flags live: in the conversion record and guardrails (FR-017), and also on non-guardrail spec values such as SLAs and durations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, contracts V-26]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it specified that terminal specs must hold no use-case values, with a rule or check that detects use-case-like values (for example, literal thresholds in control rules)? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, constitution II]

## Registry Integrity and Versioning

- [ ] CHK020 Are shared catalogues covered by the registration and immutability requirements in the same way as terminal specs (FR-019 and FR-021 mention terminals and playbooks only)? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, §FR-021, data-model `spec_catalogue`]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the behaviour defined when a playbook's content changes but its version does not? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK022 Is there a requirement for how a version is retired (command, who may run it), given that FR-021 allows retirement but no retirement action is specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, contracts/adlc-spec-cli.md]
- [ ] CHK023 Are retirement and deprecation rules for catalogues and playbooks specified, including pinned use cases that depend on a catalogue version? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the concurrency requirement measurable: what a second, concurrent registration must do (wait, then report no changes, or refuse)? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is it specified which registered version a use case without a pin should read, and is that consistent with FR-024's "active unless named"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]

## Routing Data for Demo Moments

- [ ] CHK026 Do the requirements say which routing answers each demo moment needs (D-3, D-4, D-5, D-7, D-9), and are D-6 (package hash binding through `bound_to`) and D-2 included or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the routing for T8 operational events that lead to immediate actions plus a follow-on route (`safety_breach` → reduce autonomy, then T5) fully specified in the read interface requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the T9 pass route, which is a template resolved from evidence, specified with what the read interface returns and who resolves it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024, contracts/spec-registry-interface.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK029 Can SC-003 ("100% accounted for in the conversion record") be checked objectively, given that it needs a defined list of TDS element types per terminal? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK030 Is SC-001's 10-second target tied to a reference environment, or worded so that CI and developer machines both apply? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
